en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4582 - It is narrated from Rumi ibn Zurarah, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (as) about a Christian man who married a Christian woman with a dowry of thirty jars of wine and thirty pigs. Later, they both embraced Islam, and he had not yet consummated the marriage with her.

Imam (as) said: "He should assess the value of the pigs and the wine, and send that value to her. After that, he may consummate the marriage with her, and they remain upon their original marriage contract."
